_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pipeline signals

pit_profile.why: Although cash generated by KMP’s assets is predominantly fee based and is generally not sensitive to commodity prices, the CO2-KMP business segment is exposed to commodity price risk related to the price volatility of crude oil and NGL. Risk factor: We are dependent on cash distributions received from KMP and EPB.

Risk factor: We are dependent on cash distributions received from KMP and EPB.. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 0.59x; +16% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.18; conservative 2yr -5%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -22.6%/yr (worst year FY12-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -12.6%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 3.1-yr ex-FY11 median

BULL.desc: EPS +26.1%/yr (FY12-FY14 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +26.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY14, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: KMI (retrospective, 2015-02-06) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.59x (58.9% downside to Bear $17 / +100.4% upside to Bull $83) | Adj composite 2.22 vs market 2.40: gap -0.18 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +16% above the EPP floor $36 (40x FY15E $0.89) | Conservative 2-yr case: -5.1% total (-2.5%/yr) | At 46.5x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $55 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; segment EBDA -3.8% and Natural Gas Pipelines +13.5% in Q4 2014, forward revenues +2% (no FY15 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2014 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a pipeline company on this date; none has dated evidence.
